text: Posted on r/OzempicForWeight: I've been on Semaglutide 0.5mg weekly injections for 8 weeks in Dallas, TX. Down 14 lbs and my fasting blood sugars are consistently in the 90s, but the nausea and acid reflux for the first 48 hours after each injection are brutal. My commercial insurance denied prior auth, so I'm paying $980 out of pocket per month at the pharmacy.
